note: Signature: the lash, driving foes where he wants them. Only hero with lash, shove, taunt, haste, secondwind and cleave. Icons from new icons/badguy.png (cells the Uruk-hai left).

passives.name: Iron Hide
passives.text: +2 melee and +1 missile armor per level.

passives.name: Slaver's Arm
passives.text: +1 Strength and +2% critical chance per level.

passives.name: Loud Voice
passives.text: +5 max Spirit and +1 Spirit regeneration per level.

passives.name: Spoils of War
passives.text: +2 health and +1 Spirit per kill per level.

passives.name: Scarred
passives.text: +4 max health and +1 health regeneration per level.

passives.name: Cornered Rat
passives.text: Below a quarter health he hits 3 harder per level.

passives.name: Mordor's Whip
passives.text: +8% fear resistance and +1 Accuracy per level.

skills.name: Whip Crack
skills.text: A whip crack along his facing: every foe on the line takes {amount} and is staggered {stun}s.

skills.name: Boot
skills.text: He boots the foes in front of him away: {amount} damage, and they lie stunned {stun}s.

skills.name: Over Here, Maggots!
skills.text: A bellow: foes around flinch and turn on him. For {seconds}s he takes {amount}% less damage per foe.

skills.name: Onward!
skills.text: He drives himself on: for {seconds}s he walks {amount}% faster and gains Spirit every second.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.text: He spits and laughs: heals {amount}, plus {amount} for each foe near him (up to 5).

skills.name: Leave None Alive
skills.text: For {seconds}s every blow he lands also cuts every foe around him for {amount}% of it.
